portInfo.description: The Port of San Diego operates two Embarcadero cruise terminals on North Harbor Drive. Most ships use the larger B-Street Pier & Cruise Ship Terminal; Broadway Pier’s Port Pavilion also handles cruise ships and doubles as an events/public venue. Boarding guidance: do not arrive before 10 a.m.; arrive at the assigned boarding time; drop-off beyond the gate on the pier; passports required for Mexico cruises. Passengers may not park on the pier during the cruise. West Coast homeport framing for Mexico, Hawaii and Pacific Coast itineraries appears on cruise-operations pages.

thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: For Mexico itineraries, Port of San Diego states passports are required — do not rely on birth-certificate-only myths.
